roots.name: J07 · Reviewer roles and recovery contract

nodes.text: Only report reasons harassment / safety / other are accepted. Details are optional, without a new minimum. Cancel creates no report and retains the permitted account/object draft. Native error links to Reason if missing; processing prevents duplicate submission. Determinate failure retains words and retries the same intent. Unknown checks the original request first. Received is not investigation complete; only the external support role changes In progress / Reply available. Another account sees only its own list, cannot read R-104; a public reference is never a permission token. No emergency-response promise; immediate danger uses local emergency services. Support controls are only on this review board.

roots.name: J08 · Reviewer transitions and deletion barriers

nodes.text: One request per original deletion intent. Reauthentication is valid for five minutes; expiry returns to the same intent, never auto-submits. Before 202, one atomic barrier revokes all sessions/contact/group intervals, cancels/withdraws unstarted participation, hides public projections, invalidates AI epochs and affected snapshots/exports. Any barrier failure means no partial acceptance. Preserve other people’s started-meal facts. Pre-store a 256-bit receipt in secure storage; token never goes into URLs/logs/mail. Lost response queries original receipt. Worker progress and approved policy are separate external preconditions; retry only unfinished steps. Missing receipt and Needs support always have an unauthenticated full-email exit; mail editor open is not mail sent. Source MVP lacks deletion UI: only required deletion fields and states are added using its Settings rows, Field, Notice and confirmation patterns.
